exercises.title: 1. Open and query an IFC model
exercises.description: Explore the spatial hierarchy, IFC classes, identities, and property sets.

exercises.title: 2. Geometry and the browser Viewer
exercises.description: Inspect volume and surface meshes, then view a wall and window in Binder.

exercises.title: 3. Edit, save, and extract
exercises.description: Rename an object, verify a new IFC file, and make a smaller IFC.

exercises.title: 4. Clashes and relationships
exercises.description: Compare the sample with a deliberately overlapping two-wall model.

exercises.title: 5. Create and validate (optional)
exercises.description: Create an IFC object and check a simple information requirement.
